Coverage is regional. Data is from 4 major cities (Pécs, Miskolc, Gyula), including the capital city (Budapest). Sample size 155.

People who have injected drugs in the past 12 months. Data was collected in collaboration with 6 partners (5 substance users' services and the National Institute of Public Health). Samping method was respondent drive sampling, enabling better access to hard-to-reach substance user populations.It was a multi-site study. However, majority of the respondents (n=111 from the total of 155) was from the capital city, Budapest. Other cities had significantly lower case numbers (Pécs=19, Miskolc=16, Gyula=9).
